Fetch an OSM network scoped to patch clusters, connected to an origin

Source: R/fn_download.R
osm_network_for.Rd

Pulls dense roads+trails only within boxes around each patch cluster (cluster_patches), plus a roads-only connective layer over the envelope of the origin and all clusters. The field office then drives in on one connected network to every cluster, without fetching the empty country between them (the hard part of a scattered domain). Reuses osm_access for every sub-pull, so caching, throttling and back-off all apply.

Usage

osm_network_for(
  patches,
  origin,
  crs = NULL,
  eps_km = 5,
  buffer_m = 1500,
  roads = c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "unclassified",
    "residential", "service", "living_street", "road", "track"),
  trails = c("path", "footway", "bridleway", "cycleway", "steps"),
  connect_roads = c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary"),
  path = NULL,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  tiles_connect = NULL,
  local_tile_km = 20,
  contract = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

patches

sf points/polygons to scope the pull to.

origin

the trip origin (field office): an sf point, or a numeric c(lon, lat) in EPSG:4326.

crs

planar CRS (metres) to work in; defaults to the patches' CRS.

eps_km

cluster join distance (km, default 5; see cluster_patches).

buffer_m

buffer (m) added around each cluster's bounding box (default 1500).

roads, trails

OSM highway classes pulled densely within cluster boxes (trails only there).

connect_roads

the (major) road classes for the connective envelope layer that links the origin to the clusters — default the through-routes motorway/trunk/primary/secondary/tertiary. Residential/service/track are left out here: they are local bloat and already come from the cluster pulls.

path

GeoPackage for the merged network (NULL -> cwd).

cache_dir

folder for the per-pull checkpoints (NULL -> beside path); existing pulls are reused, so the whole fetch is resumable.

tiles_connect

tiles for the connective roads pull (NULL -> ~1 per 30 km of envelope width).

local_tile_km

target tile width (km) for each cluster's dense pull, so a big habitat block is not one enormous Overpass query (default 20).

contract

simplify the merged network to junction-to-junction edges before writing (default TRUE; contract_network) — the on-disk file is then the contracted version, ~30x fewer graph nodes.

...

passed to osm_access (e.g. endpoint, contact, pause).

Value

a list: network (merged sf lines, deduped), origin (sf point in crs) and clusters (centroids with cluster ids); attribute path is where the network was written. Feed network + origin to accessibility.
